heading: Privacy Policy
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy explains how SEO Group Buy collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you use our website and services.
We collect information you provide during registration and checkout, such as name, email, and payment-related details needed to deliver tool access.
We do not sell your personal data. You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data by contacting support@seogroupbuy.in.
